schema.name: Find Your Space in the Library
schema.description: As a commuter or transfer student, stepping past the first floor of the University Library can feel uncertain or intimidating. You might wonder which spaces are best for focused studying, hanging out with friends, or taking a well-deserved nap and what the noise expectations are for each area. The University Library is here to help you confidently explore, navigate, and claim the spaces that fit your lifestyle and learning needs.        Lunch will be provided.    We’d love for you to RSVP, and feel free to bring a friend or two.    Location: Learning Commons, Viewing & Production-B (LC 133)    11125721933
